supported_contract: Only official CCCL/CUB v2.8.2 commit above; no equivalence claim for other versions. CUDA source is the repository pinned evaluate_splits.cu, Numerical (32 lanes), strict Update, and left-preserving feature operator+. Nonprimitive DeviceSplitCandidate, default policies.
warp_order: warp_reduce.cuh selects shuffle implementation for power-of-two 32. Generic ReduceStep(input, shuffle_down(input, offset)) uses offsets 1,2,4,8,16. ArgMax returns b iff b.value>a.value or (a.value==b.value and b.key<a.key). Induction over each contiguous 2^step range proves lane 0 obtains maximal value and smallest lane key among equal values. Signed zeros compare equal; NaN and +inf are rejected before reduction; -inf is invalid. Strict greater chunk updates preserve earliest winning chunk.
feature_order: AgentReduce nonprimitive input disables vectorization. Policy300/350/600 all nominate 256 threads; MemBoundScaling of the 56-byte CUDA DeviceSplitCandidate retains 256 threads (items/thread = 1). Policy1000 has no custom-type tuning and falls back to Policy600. ConsumeTile reads block-striped indices t,t+256,..., preserving earlier stripe entry on equality. BlockReduceWarpReductions reduces each 32-thread warp with offsets 1,2,4,8,16 and lane zero applies warp aggregates 1..7 in order. Thus ties prioritize input position modulo 256, then input position divided by 256; input 256 beats input 1 on a tied maximum. For <=256 features this is ordinary first-input precedence. The implementation follows this metadata traversal, not minimum feature id.
proof_limits: Source-only acquisition and inspection, no CUDA compiler/device execution or empirical CUDA parity.
No all-CUB-version equivalence claim. Future versions/policies/custom accumulator layouts require review.
Left-preserving maximum is associative only over the rejected-NaN domain; signed zeros retain winning operand bits.
NPU correctness-oriented serial vector-core selection; no performance acceptance or native training claim.

Unselected result uses normalized -inf and UINT32_MAX ids instead of CUDA internal -FLT_MAX/no feature sentinel, while preserving the strict initial > -FLT_MAX comparison (the exact finite -FLT_MAX edge does not create a split).
Quantization exponent provenance remains caller metadata, as in existing scorer; histogram/runtime ownership is guarded.
